# Media regression fixture

`bear-320x240.webm` is Chromium's 219,229-byte media test sample, included solely to verify real
offline video decoding. Its size is justified by the audio/video export acceptance test.

- Source: <https://github.com/chromium/chromium/blob/main/media/test/data/bear-320x240.webm>
- Source blob: `a1b4150b32f880fae91fdf274437faa91be1ba6f`
- SHA-256: `834dbadab368d6dbdeaf973d8f2398a36d6fe584965781877ee46ffcc570ed59`
- Upstream description: <https://github.com/chromium/chromium/blob/main/media/test/data/README.md>
- Original Chromium copyright and BSD notice: [LICENSE.chromium](LICENSE.chromium).

The WAV fixture is generated by the test. No recording hardware or encoder is required.

`Ahem.ttf` (21,768 bytes) is WPT's public-domain layout test font, used to verify actual embedded
font decoding. Its glyph boxes are intentional. See [LICENSE.ahem](LICENSE.ahem), the original
[WPT source](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/fonts/Ahem.ttf), and
[W3C's declaration](https://www.w3.org/Style/CSS/Test/Fonts/Ahem/).
SHA-256: `b719ecb31c5b21fc573c03f6421c74ac63c271a5a3ff841e34f9705fb94b8448`.
